answer: Each agent opens a dune outlet and a juniper inlet, locks 60 credits, and files a flow batch; dune outlet units carry a plume receipt and juniper inlet units carry its match. The juniper ledger pairs receipts and requires inflow equal to outflow; an unpaired or reused receipt burns the bond. The k-th fake identity needs a fresh pair and pays 30+8(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fake identities lock 60,000 credits and pay 4,026,000 in fees, none shared. A rented-receipt ring fails because each plume receipt is key-bound to one outlet and inlet. An honest agent pays one bond and one 30-credit fee.
